policy: Canonical consumer-row inventory for production dimension symbols that currently traverse the facade through runtime and services. capturedProductionHead names the latest committed production snapshot and is deliberately not a self-reference to metadata-only commits. The public-surface manifest owns the complete routed and routed-but-unconsumed symbol inventory.
